query: SELECT p.oid,p.proname,pg_catalog.pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,pg_catalog.encode(extensions.digest(pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.replace(p.prosrc,E'\r\n',E'\n'),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS body_lf_sha256,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,p.proowner,p.proacl,pg_catalog.to_jsonb(p)-'prosrc' AS preserved_metadata FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='api' AND p.proname IN ('wave5_cash_date_command','wave5_cash_save_v2') ORDER BY p.proname
